Q5651.reason: The 'as is' clause disclaims implied warranties but cannot negate the express warranty/description of the car as a 1964 model, so Carol likely prevails.

Q5672.reason: An acquittal based on self-defense means the killing was justified (no crime), whereas insanity or diminished capacity are personal excuses that don't absolve the instigator.

Q8537.reason: Keeping the definition value-neutral prevents the justification question from being settled in advance by definition.
